Stock market news | Anthropic drops below $83 IPO price

On 24 November 2026, Anthropic's shares slipped below the $83 price set at its IPO. Multiple outlets reported the drop in pre-market trading after a strong debut.
The reversal shows volatility after a record listing, a reminder for investors tracking global tech IPOs.
